contexts.text: Minute as the hoar-frost upon the earth () = truth in the form of good in a consistent and flowing [state]. Hoar-frost = in the form of good. The good of truth... is compared to hoar-frost from its being continuous relatively to snow. Snow, being small and white, is predicated of truth; but hoar-frost, being continuous, is predicated of truth made good, which is the good of truth.
